entries.scientificReview: Three trait continua and trade-off qualification inspected. Historical r/K labels remain tendencies, not universal categories or sufficient recovery predictions.

Native 100/10/1 percent logarithmic axis and all three forms inspected. Type II is straight on log survival, representing exponential survival and constant mortality risk. Zero is excluded explicitly; curves are idealized cohort forms.
Both columns and all four effect pairs checked. Antagonistic +/− can cover predation, parasitism and herbivory; effects require measurement and do not identify mechanism from abundance curves alone.

Zero-baseline bars reproduce supplied 4.0/3.0/2.4 g mean A mass. Final two groups each have ten plants; first comparison changes intraspecific density. Replication and resource evidence are still required.

Two qualitative panels share a resource dimension, with species separated by line style. Together curves narrow and overlap less; matched-condition assumption and alternative site effects remain explicit. Fresh stable screenshot confirms full heading; initial capture artifact did not require an SVG change.

Abstract stripe swatches encode resemblance only. Batesian relatively undefended mimic/defended model contrasts with Müllerian both defended. No false specimen, species identification, toxicity proof or intentional adaptation.

Common zero-to-100 count axis, time0–12 and solid/dashed keys inspected. Prey peaks2/8, predator4/10, two-step lag. Counts explicitly fictional, separate from pelt records; alternative causes retained.

Native rock and retained-soil profiles, roots, process arrows and two possible branches inspected. Neither timescale nor final climax is fixed; disturbance name alone does not classify starting condition.

All four factor combinations verified: reference, habitat only, reduced predator access only, both. Recruitment measurement is proposed without fabricated results. Replication, multiple evaluation criteria and respectful engagement remain visible.
